fact: The Minister of Urban Planning said in February 2025 that Niamey has had an addressing plan since 2004, used by NIGELEC, NDE, SONITEL and DGI, and that it is being redone with the city and AMVN to cover other districts and the new street names.
title: Entretien accordé à la RTN par le ministre de l'Urbanisme et de l'Habitat, M. Salissou Sahirou Adamou
